findings.observed: At seed 101003, revised T2 boss packages killed 6/6 versus 2/6 opening packages; all six revised rows are valid boss-kill terminals.
findings.interpretation: The combined T2 package revision materially changed this matched screening result, including reactive Brace and the declared offensive substitutions.
findings.limitation: This is one reused seed and a complete-package comparison; it does not isolate Brace or any single ability.

findings.observed: At seed 101003, revised T3 boss packages killed 2/6 versus 3/6 opening packages; Striker changed from a kill to bot-died while Slinger and Spirit remained kills.
findings.interpretation: The T3 package changes are not uniformly protective; removing the prior Frenzy delivery from the affected boss packages is a confounder alongside Brace.
findings.limitation: No control replay or component-isolated comparison is authorized by the packet.

findings.observed: 5/6 revised T4 boss rows match their opening outcome, elapsedMs and minPlayerHpFraction exactly; T4 Conduit also killed at 288000 ms but its minPlayerHpFraction changed from 0.46479253731343284 to 0.8563432835820896.
findings.interpretation: T4 boss completion and elapsed time were stable across the matched screen, while one Conduit row changed observed survivability telemetry.
findings.limitation: The packet compares complete packages and does not isolate Brace, destination ordering or any one ability; this remains one reused seed.

findings.observed: T4 Squire farming changed from a 300000 ms window with 49 kills to player-died at 216000 ms with 36 kills and 4 unfinished bodies.
findings.interpretation: The revised offensive ordering is a concrete T4 Squire farming regression under the sealed package; this row is not sustain-eligible.
findings.limitation: The row is death-truncated, and the package changes multiple ordered abilities rather than one isolated AoE choice.

findings.observed: Conduit remained mixed: T3 farm died at 96500 ms with 4 kills versus 110300 ms and 3 kills opening; T4 farm completed its window with 39 kills versus 51 opening.
findings.interpretation: The retained formation telemetry shows delivery and share-loss events; raw damage alone cannot establish the cause of the changed progression.
findings.limitation: The packet declares no Conduit redesign and the T3 row is death-truncated; owner-position and formation evidence remain descriptive.

findings.observed: Across boss diagnostics, 32 charge-completion-window hits were matched: Brace was active in 17, inactive in 15, and boundary-ambiguous in 0; 118 charge wind-ups began with observed Brace cooldown remaining and 186 charge windows had no matched damage hit.
findings.interpretation: Brace activation and overlap are real observed events but coverage is not universal; charge windows without hits remain unknown rather than inferred dodges.
findings.limitation: The report does not convert these observations into counterfactual damage savings or a universal coverage rate.
